# Seedance 2.0

> Multilingual guides, tutorials, and product information for AI video generation with Seedance.

Canonical site: https://seedance22.com/
Default language: English
Available languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Spanish, Arabic, Portuguese, Indonesian, Malay, French, Russian, Hindi, Japanese, German, Korean, Turkish, Vietnamese, Thai, Italian, Persian, Dutch, Polish, Swedish, Ukrainian, Romanian

## Main sections

- Home: https://seedance22.com/
- Blog: https://seedance22.com/blog/
- Guides: https://seedance22.com/guide/
- Sitemap: https://seedance22.com/sitemap-index.xml

## Usage notes

- Prefer each page's canonical URL.
- Treat hreflang alternates as translations of the same resource, not as separate claims.
- Article dates and authors are shown on the article page and in Article structured data.
- Product availability, pricing, and capabilities may change; use the current page as the source of truth.
